name: LEDA Scholars Program (Aspects of Leadership Summer Institute)
summary: A completely free seven-week residential summer institute and college prep program hosted at top university campuses for low-income public high school juniors.
subject: Leadership
description: LEDA identifies promising student leaders from socioeconomically disadvantaged backgrounds and provides academic writing instruction, standardized test preparation, leadership training, and campus life experience. LEDA continues providing individual college advising and support through high school senior year and college graduation.
eligibility: High school juniors attending U.S. public high schools with a 3.5+ GPA and household income typically under $90,000.
cost: 100% free; covers all tuition, room, board, learning materials, and travel costs.
deadline: Applications open in September and close in December.
